stops.note: a personal name derived from Iulius (Julius)
the French form of the name, borne by an otherwise unrecorded chef
literally 'soup in Julien's manner', naming a clear soup of finely cut vegetables
stops.meaning: a vegetable soup named for a cook

stops.note: entered for the soup, then narrowed to the technique of cutting vegetables into thin strips

current_meaning: vegetables or other food cut into long, thin strips
